cover.title: How I Stay In Shape As A Streamer
cover.sub: 8+ hours at a desk, 3 workouts a week and zero crazy diets

slides.text:
this is my office most days, so I plan
my movement like I plan my streams

3 strength workouts a week, never 6
(the ones I actually show up for)

5-minute warm-up with my rope
before every session

10-min incline walk after lifting,
my favourite way to switch off

protein at every meal,
meal-prepped for 4 days

and a breakfast I actually
look forward to

my free 5-minute desk stretch
for between matches 🩷
comment STRETCH and I'll send it

streaming is my job,
my body is my setup 🎮
want a plan built for you? quiz in bio
